description.value: Masset Oceanview Hotel is a small, independently run motel situated on the waterfront in downtown Masset on Haida Gwaii, offering spacious 525-square-foot rooms with harbour views and a complimentary made-to-order hot breakfast. Its central location puts guests within easy walking distance of shops and dining in one of the few service hubs on the islands. Reviewer comments highlight friendly, accommodating hosts and clean, well-maintained rooms — a notable asset for cyclists who have endured remote stretches of Haida Gwaii's limited road network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms OSM contact details (phone, address, email). The site describes rooms, breakfast, Wi-Fi, and parking but contains no mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, laundry, drying areas, or any cycling-specific amenities. The 'Contractor Friendly' note mentions 'large room for equipment and ample parking lot' but this is not described as secure or bike-specific.
concerns: Website provides no information about bike storage, bike handling, or any cycling-specific services; both required criteria are unverifiable without direct contact.
Website address includes city/postal code ('Masset BC V0T 1M0') not present in the OSM addr tags — address_confirmed set to true as values are consistent, but OSM record lacks full civic address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel is a real, operating property in a remote but cycling-relevant destination (Haida Gwaii), but neither required criterion — secure bike storage nor staff bike procedure knowledge — could be confirmed from the website. Direct outreach is needed before a WWC listing can be justified.
enrichment_extras.notes: Given the property's location on Haida Gwaii — a remote, bucket-list cycling destination with very limited accommodation options — it may be worth a direct contact to establish whether bike storage exists, even informally (e.g., locked shed, storage room, or bikes-in-room policy).
